ruleName: Ball in Teeing Area Accidentally Falls Off Tee or Is Knocked Off Tee
title: Practice Swing Knocks Ball Off Tee
question: You are preparing to play your first shot from the teeing area. During a practice swing, your club accidentally knocks the teed ball off the tee. What is the correct ruling?

choices.text: You have played your first stroke and must play the ball from where it came to rest.
There is no penalty. You may re-tee the ball or play it from the ground within the teeing area.
You must replace the ball on the tee and add one penalty stroke.

explanation: A stroke in golf requires the intention to strike the ball. If you accidentally knock your teed ball off the tee during a practice swing, you have not made a stroke. There is no penalty. Since the ball was still in the teeing area, you may re-tee the ball or play it from its new position within the teeing area. This is covered by Rule 6.2b(5) and the definition of 'stroke'.
